complete_examples.text: From the viewpoint of higher mathematics, it is shown that the receptance function and the unit impulse response function are related by the Fourier transform and inverse Fourier transform in a stationary reference frame.

Another approach is to establish the system matrices by programming language where the receptance can be computed at a series of frequency sampling points so that the Green’s function can be derived through the inverse Fourier transform, see [47].
